bayts.text: I have turned my whole being, with praise and thanksgiving, to the Protector of the believers (Allah), the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr).
Be, O Protector, O All-Powerful, O Helper, the support of the believers: truly You are the Guide, the All-Seeing.
You have swiftly turned away from us, towards others, whoever is not a believer, O Lord of Time (Allah).
You have swiftly turned away from us, towards others, whoever is not a Muslim, O Lord of Time (Allah).
You have swiftly turned away from us, towards others, whoever is not a doer of excellence (muḥsin), O Lord of Time (Allah).
You have blessed us with the most excellent of faiths: so extend to all the blessing of security.
Through it (faith) and through Islam You have guarded us: so guard everyone from blame.
You placed foremost the Master of creation (Muḥammad) — O Aḥmad! — and the Prophets and the Messengers, O You who are praised (Allah).
Bring to them forever blessing and peace, just as You covered with disgrace whoever did not worship You.
To the Prophet (Muḥammad) bring blessing and peace, and to the Prophets and the Messengers, O You who sent down the Word (Allah).
Upon the Prophet Muḥammad and his Family pour forth Your blessing and Your peace, and answer my plea.
For the Chosen One (Muḥammad) decree, without end, what gladdens him, and accept my service.
Facilitate for the Master of creation (Muḥammad) that which he has chosen, O Everlasting (Allah), who made him the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār).
O Bestower of benefit (An-Nāfiʿ), pour forth forever blessing and peace upon him (Muḥammad) who leads to You whoever worships You.
Decree a blessing for all the Prophets and the Messengers, joined with peace, and accept my writings with gratitude.
O Bestower of benefit, pour forth with reverence blessing and peace upon the Prophet (Muḥammad), his Family and the noble Companions.
May the blessing of the Lord of the Mighty Throne, the Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), be upon the Prophet (Muḥammad), his Family and those who praise.
Turn back the schemes of the enemies upon the enemies themselves, O You who granted me that which confounds the enemies.
Bring to every Muslim man and every Muslim woman a joy, O You who have sufficed me against the oppressors.
To every believing man and every believing woman bring abiding glad tidings, for the Sufis, people of spiritual purity.
To every doer of good, man and woman, extend the loftiest glad tidings, seen as worthy of all praise.
Turn towards the community of the Messenger of God (Muḥammad) — upon him the best of God's blessings —
the aid of Him (Allah) who, when He says "Be!", it is; O You who bring into being wishes that were not yet.
Today I have addressed You in intimate prayer with praise and thanksgiving, on behalf of the believers, O Protector, O Appreciative.
The "Be, and it is" (Kun fa-yakūn) leads to me, from You, what I need, without rancour or dispute.
You have banished Iblīs (Satan) forever towards others than me, in this month, and likewise whoever has not worshipped.
Turn towards those who have believed, submitted and done good that which confounds those who have not submitted.
Bring into being, for the community of the Prophet (Muḥammad) — may the Lord, sublime in His majesty, bless him and grant him peace —
an answer that drives the enemies away from them, towards others, forever, and with them every ill.
O Bestower of benefit, O Generous, O Vigilant Guardian (Al-Muhaymin), answer me and him who keeps watch under Your guardianship.
They have kept (the faith): protect the community of the best of Messengers (Muḥammad) from those who disbelieved in the Messengers.
Bring them, without delay, the mighty victory, and give them glad tidings, in this life and in the life to come.
Bring to the people of faith that which increases love for You, O You with whom is boundless increase.
Free the people of Islam from any need to lean upon Your enemies or to find rest with them.
Upon the Prophet and Messenger (Muḥammad), the sure Refuge, pour forth blessing and peace, O You who annihilate whoever has denied.
To the Chosen One (Muḥammad), his Family and the noble Companions convey Your two salutations of peace, and grant me generously what I seek.
O You to whom belong creation and the fullness of all things, O Enricher (Al-Mughnī): You have freed me from any need of what hearts conceal.
Today and yesterday I have addressed You in intimate prayer, full of hope, and beyond any doubt You have fulfilled my need.
Bring to the community of the Prophet Aḥmad (Muḥammad) — as I invoke blessing upon him, among those who are praised —
a mighty victory embracing the great together with the small; and subdue for them whoever challenges them.
Preserve the Ḥadīth and the derived sciences (al-furūʿ), as well as the Book (the Qur'an), from those who have refused repentance.
O Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), through me raise high the Book (the Qur'an) and the derived sciences, together with the authentic Ḥadīth, O Lord of splendour.
You have given me everything without taking anything away, and for me You bring what I ask at the very moment of asking.
Bring to me what I desire and, through me, benefit the creatures, O You who make the cannon needless.
Through the Chosen One (Muḥammad) You erased every intent to harm me, and led to me what the God-fearing love.
You have turned towards me that which never ceases to be a marvel, for ever, for the righteous, the elect.
You have extended to me the aid of Him (Allah) from whom nothing is hidden; You have bestowed on me what is most secret.
You have repelled whoever hated me, and he fled towards what afflicts him without respite, laden with anguish.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O All-Seeing, O All-Powerful, O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O Helper!
You have saved from the devils, all together, those who have attached themselves to me: so hear my thanksgiving.
I have turned my thanksgiving to the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), the King, the Most Merciful, Lord of the ages.
He honoured me in my dwelling and in my land; the One who honours (Allah) has purified my soul with security.
